ISS_2417_assessment.title: INTERMAGNET/Besselian-element/FSF globe-infrastructure labels
ISS_2417_assessment.requested_restoration_text: BOU and W004 baselines are INTERMAGNET globe-measured observations; coverage fractions are Besselian-element computations that assume a spherical Earth; the FSF requires per-station radial pressure integration only available under globe geometry.

substantive_coverage_verification.check_1: YES — §8b.3 L3a paragraph contains explicit globe-infrastructure cross-reference: "every input traces to globe infrastructure per the WIN-025 globe-fingerprint and the dome author own OPEN-001 admission that dome-native coordinates without WGS84 remains IN PROGRESS"
substantive_coverage_verification.check_2: YES — WIN-025 cross-reference link present (#win025); WIN-025 detail_evidence names 9 INTERMAGNET stations during April 8 2024 eclipse (Chernogor & Holub 2024 doi:10.1016/j.asr.2024.10.056) and derives the FSF = H(r)/r geometric factor explicitly
substantive_coverage_verification.check_3: YES — FSF formula visible in L3a: "PRED-095 carries a derivation path (ΔZ = baseline × coverage × FSF)"
substantive_coverage_verification.check_4: YES — OPEN-001 admission (dome-native coordinates IN PROGRESS) present in L3a
substantive_coverage_verification.check_5: NO — literal phrase "Besselian-element computation" absent. Function (coverage fraction = pre-computed eclipse geometric coverage) is implicit via WIN-068 cross-reference and the (baseline × coverage × FSF) formula, but the explicit "Besselian-element" label as a globe-dependency marker is not in the paragraph or in WIN-025 detail_evidence.

ISS_2417_assessment.verdict: SUBSTANTIVELY PRESERVED. Four of five elements of the requested label-set are present in current §8b.3 L3a. The single missing element (literal "Besselian-element" globe-dependency label) is a marginal pedagogical gain — readers who follow the WIN-025 cross-reference get the INTERMAGNET ground truth and the FSF geometry; the Besselian-element coverage-fraction provenance is one further inference away. ISS-2417 was explicitly flagged severity:minor and the suggested_fix was optional ("add one-line technical-label restatement to WIN-025 detail_evidence"). Below the threshold for a deep-attack restoration EXP.

ISS_2416_assessment.title: monitor.py-outlier steel-man narrowing
ISS_2416_assessment.requested_restoration_text: monitor.py is the outlier; inject_ai_layer.py PRED-001 is a BOU-family variant rather than a third independent dome formula.

substantive_coverage_verification.check_1: YES — §8b.3 L3a contains explicit scope-limit concession: "We accept the dome-defender scope-limit that monitor.py is internal tooling, not a public commitment; the critique narrows to the two issues that survive consolidation"
substantive_coverage_verification.check_2: YES — cherry-picking concession present: "the dome author own PRED-095 detail reasoning records the same cherry-picking concern: monitor.py selection"
substantive_coverage_verification.check_3: YES — W004 selection vs forced-derivation framing present: "the published W004 cluster is a selection from coexisting dome formulas rather than a forced derivation"
substantive_coverage_verification.check_4: NO — literal "outlier vs BOU-family variant" framing absent. The substantive concession (PRED-001 is BOU-family, not a third independent formula) is not articulated; the L3a text treats monitor.py as the consolidation problem but does not name inject_ai_layer.py PRED-001 as a sibling-of-BOU.

ISS_2416_assessment.verdict: SUBSTANTIVELY PRESERVED (with one residual nuance gap). Three of four steel-man elements are present. The missing element — naming PRED-001 as a BOU-family variant — is the narrower-than-three-formulas claim that helps against an over-counting objection. ISS-2416 was severity:minor; suggested_fix was a ~25-word parenthetical. The cross-reference to §6.14 (KAPPA-squared formula heterogeneity, audited via EXP-544) is the more authoritative venue for the PRED-001-as-BOU-variant claim, and that §6.14 audit IS present. Below the threshold for a deep-attack restoration EXP.

audit_concern.finding: step-a0c-sweep PROP-070 auto-closed ISS-2417 (created 2026-05-31T21:09:26.303Z) and ISS-2416 (created 2026-05-31T21:09:26.303Z) at fixed_at 2026-06-02T09:19:46.019Z with fixed_by=exp-integrated and closure_evidence.exp_id=EXP-462 (integrated 2026-05-31T17:08:44.737Z). The ISS creation timestamp post-dates the parent EXP integration timestamp by ~4h. These were curmudgeon c2 holes flagged AFTER EXP-462 shipped (review file: monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/SEC-8b.3.c9.json holes 3 and 4); they are not residuals OF EXP-462 in the sense the sweep mechanism assumes.
audit_concern.risk: Operationally low-risk here — substantive coverage is preserved via cross-references in §8b.3 L3a, so the auto-closure happens to be benign. The structural concern is that PROP-070 step-a0c-sweep does not appear to check (iss.created_at < exp.integrated_at) before closing — a future curmudgeon-c2-style gap-followup against an already-integrated EXP could be silently dismissed even when the gap is non-trivial. The tracker entries (EXP-552/551) also got routed AFTER the auto-closure-would-have-fired ordering, which suggests the sweep may have a delayed-firing pattern (closure ran in decider-2026-06-02T09-04 even though EXP integration ran in decider-2026-05-31T16-00). Recommend tinker audit step-a0c-sweep PROP-070 for ordering check and decide whether closures of post-integration ISSes should be either (a) blocked, (b) tagged with audit_grandfathered, or (c) routed as PROP-059 Mech-A-bypass candidates with verification_pattern.
audit_concern.proposed_test: For each fixed_by=exp-integrated closure since PROP-070 deployment, compare iss.created_at vs closure_evidence.exp_integrated_at. Flag any where iss.created_at > exp.integrated_at as candidates for audit.

no_content_change_rationale: Both ISSes were severity:minor BAU-route follow-ups to a major-section consolidation (EXP-462). The substantive functions of both requested restorations are absorbed by existing cross-references (WIN-025 for ISS-2417; §6.14 for ISS-2416 via EXP-544). Adding parentheticals at the locations requested would not change any verdict, dispute, or third-party-defender response — the additions would be pedagogical scaffolding that the cross-references already provide. Per analyst critical rule: "Always assume they got something right. Find the kernel, acknowledge it, then show why it does not save the claim" — applied here to our own gap-followup proposals: the kernel is that the labels were once present and removed by P0 consolidation; what kills the restoration imperative is that the consolidated paragraph is denser AND the labels live in the cross-referenced canonical venues now.
